title: Design 'Spectrum Cards' color lanes and modular 5-step type scale for micro-layouts
creator: Noah Patel
description: Background: Several product teams reported inconsistent color behavior and brittle spacing in high-density table rows and small chart cards when the UI switches between compact and comfortable modes. Current token sets contain many near-duplicate neutrals and ad-hoc shadow presets which create visual jitter at small sizes. Goal: Introduce a small, opinionated set of semantic color lanes we call 'Spectrum Cards' (6 lanes per semantic intent) plus a modular 5-step type scale tuned for micro-layouts. Provide tactile spacing & radius rules and a simplified elevation map (3 levels) so small components read consistently across density. Deliverables: color lanes token file, type-scale token file, spacing/radius token guidelines, elevation shadow presets, updated Figma components for table row / mini-chart card, engineering token migration plan.
acceptance_criteria: Provide tokens: spectrum-cards-{intent}-{0..5} naming pattern and JSON export in tokens repo
Modular 5-step type scale defined (XS, S, M, Base, L) with line-height and tokenized font weights
Spacing cadence: tactile-gap (4,8,12,16) mapped to compact/comfortable mode with migration notes
Elevation map reduced to 3 perceptually distinct shadows with CSS variables and examples for 8px and 12px corner radii
Figma library updated: table row and mini-chart components use new tokens with visual QA in dark/light/HC modes
Engineering acceptance: ENG has a migration PR that swaps tokens behind a feature flag and passes visual regression tests
Accessibility: color contrast for all primary and interactive states meets WCAG 2.1 AA for normal text and 3.0 for UI components where required
comments: 2026-03-10 - Noah Patel: Initial spec uploaded; identified three pain points from design audits: color drift in charts, spacing collapse in dense rows, and noisy elevation at small radii. Linked baseline screenshots.

2026-03-11 - Ava Rodrigo: Draft palette exploration done. Moving from 12-step neutrals to 6-step lanes to reduce token surface area and avoid near-duplicates. Will prototype in Figma with 24px and 40px chart cards.

2026-03-13 - Accessibility review (Samir Khan): Early pass: two color lane variants fail for 14px labels on colored backgrounds; proposed swap for darker lane at index 2. Recommend adding explicit contrast test harness to CI.

2026-03-14 - Engineering sync (Lina Gómez): ENG agrees to behind-flag rollout. Will implement CSS variables mapping and visual diff tests. Estimated work: ENG-2849 (token loader updates) + visual regression job additions.
